changeSet.author: liquibase

preConditions.onFailMessage: Payment partition is absent or not attached; skip this changeset.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_inherits inh JOIN pg_class child ON child.oid = inh.inhrelid JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = child.relnamespace WHERE inh.inhparent = 'fdr3.payment'::regclass AND ns.nspname = 'fdr3' AND child.relname = 'payment_p202608' AND child.relkind = 'r'

changeSet.comment: Validate an existing archive recovery index, then create the missing index concurrently on the payment partition.
changeSet.sql: DO $validation$ BEGIN IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_class idx JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = idx.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = idx.oid LEFT JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = idx.relam WHERE ns.nspname = 'fdr3' AND idx.relname = 'payment_p202608_pay_date_flow_id_flow_date_idx' AND NOT COALESCE( idx.relkind = 'i' AND am.amname = 'btree' AND ix.indrelid = 'fdr3.payment_p202608'::regclass AND ix.indisvalid AND ix.indisready AND NOT ix.indisunique AND ix.indnatts = 3 AND ix.indnkeyatts = 3 AND ix.indpred IS NULL AND ix.indexprs IS NULL AND ix.indoption::text = '0 0 0' AND pg_get_indexdef(idx.oid, 1, true) = 'pay_date' AND pg_get_indexdef(idx.oid, 2, true) = 'flow_id' AND pg_get_indexdef(idx.oid, 3, true) = 'flow_date', FALSE ) ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid or incompatible index: payment_p202608_pay_date_flow_id_flow_date_idx'; END IF; END $validation$;
